KSI-210/ORT/OGE

Gynaecology Table

Electric Operated

An electric obstetric and gynaecology table for examinations, natural deliveries, caesarean sections and urological treatment.

Includes a reverse Trendelenburg function (30°). The removable leg section and integrated side railings add flexibility and patient safety.
